pr.title: Add notices and snoozing to the inbox
pr.head: 7fc6900fecd401b0af856cf30e84e21e389c5f49

summary: Projector's inbox holds what an agent puts in front of you while it keeps working. Until now it held only questions: an agent runs project inbox ask, or calls the ask tool in Claude Code, and the question waits in a per-session store on disk until you answer it. Projector's band, the panel above the Claude Code prompt, lists the questions, and your answer goes back to the agent.

An agent often has something to tell you that needs no answer, such as the result of something you asked it to check, or a force-push it made. Bending a question to carry that puts a fake choice in front of you. And an item you cannot deal with yet either sits in front of you or gets dismissed and lost. This pull request, the second layer of the inbox plan on top of #278's rename, adds two things:

• Notices. A notice is an item you read and dismiss. An agent posts one with project inbox tell or the new tell tool. It takes the next number in the same counts as questions, so a notice about #12 after one question is #12.2. It has no options, and nothing goes back to the agent, so dismissing it also marks it delivered at once.
  • Snoozing. project inbox snooze hides an open item of either kind for an hour, or for --for minutes. The store records a time, snoozedUntil, rather than a state, so nothing has to run when a snooze ends: list and the band compare it with the clock.
The plan stays in-progress, because one acceptance row, opening an item's drawer on the main screen under tmux, needs a check by hand.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Item: one entry in a session's inbox, either a question or a notice, stored as one JSON file.
  • Deliverer: whatever carries a question's answer back to the agent, either project inbox watch or the band. It claims the answer, sends it, then marks it delivered.
  • Band: Projector's panel above the Claude Code prompt, drawn by the hooks module in hooks/.
  • Drawer: the expanded view of one item in the band, with its detail and its actions.
  • Tick: the band's 5-second timer, which reads the store and runs the deliverer.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• One Projector review, of 7fc6900, requested changes with one finding: two new lines in docs/plugins.md break the paragraph's wrapping.
  • It suggested two changes: making snooze --for 0 bring a hidden band back as a snooze that runs out does, and removing three comments in hooks/register.tsx that describe the code below them.
  • The full gate passed: 896 Python tests with 1 skip, the plan check, both plugin validations, and 62 hook tests.

groups.title: The store and the CLI
groups.kicker: A second item kind and a snooze time in the per-session store, and the commands that use them
intro: The store keeps each session's items as JSON files under projector/inbox/<session>/, every write under the directory's lock. Each record already carried a kind, which until now was always question. This group adds notice as a second kind and the tell command that writes one. The old ask splits into checks both kinds share, in check_subject, and a post function that numbers and records either kind.

Every command that delivers handles questions only. answer and claim refuse a notice with exit 65, naming dismiss. dismiss sets a notice's deliveredAt together with its dismissal, so watch, which looks for answers without deliveredAt, never sees it.

snooze records snoozedUntil, in milliseconds, and --for 0 removes it. Answering or dismissing an item clears it, so a resolved item never comes back. list gains a kind column and shows a snoozed item as snoozed until <HH:MM>.

checks.text: No notice reaches a deliverer. undelivered keeps only items with an answer and no deliveredAt, and dismiss is the only way a notice gets an answer, which always sets deliveredAt beside it. test_dismissing_a_notice_delivers_it_at_once runs watch --once after the dismissal and expects no output; it passed on this head.

files.note: Adds tell, snooze, and snoozed_until, splits ask into shared checks and post, and makes dismiss, answer, claim, and context handle a notice.

checks.text: load_items now skips a file whose kind is neither question nor notice. The rename in #278 already wrote kind: question on every record, and the store of earlier releases lives in another directory, so no record this CLI wrote is skipped.
A notice's dismissal is its delivery: the same timestamp goes in answer.answeredAt and deliveredAt, which also starts pruning, since each session keeps only its 100 most recently delivered items.

--for 0 removes snoozedUntil rather than setting it to now. The band brings a hidden band back only when it sees a snoozedUntil pass, so waking an item this way returns it to the list without showing a band you hid. The review suggested setting it to the current time instead.

files.note: Adds the tell and snooze subcommands, the kind column in list, and the snoozed and dismissed states in item_state; show prints no choices for a notice.

checks.text: list's tab-separated text output gains a column, the kind, after the reference. The band reads list --json, which this does not change, and no skill parses the text form.

files.note: Adds NoticeTests, SnoozeTests, and NoticeContextTests, and the kind column in the existing list tests.

groups.title: The band in Claude Code
groups.kicker: The tell tool, notices in the list, the snooze action, and waking a hidden band
intro: The hooks module in hooks/ runs inside Claude Code. It registers the agent's tools and draws the band, reading the store through project inbox list --json whenever the store's directory changes. This group adds a tell tool beside ask, which the model sees as mcp__projector__tell. Both tools now share one post helper that runs the CLI and turns its exit code into a refusal.

Item in hooks/types.d.ts becomes a union of Question and Notice. The deliverer, needsDelivery, and the reader of answers in a sent prompt, answersIn, accept only a question, so the type system stops a notice from reaching them.

In the band, a notice's line starts with • where a question's starts with -. The divider counts open questions and open notices separately, and every drawer ends with three plain buttons, discuss | dismiss | snooze. isShownAt leaves a snoozed item out of the list, and pressing snooze closes its drawer. On each tick while the band is hidden, wokeBetween looks for an open item whose snooze ended since the previous tick and shows the band for it.

checks.text: Waking is measured from the previous tick, held in the module variable tickedAt. The first tick after the module loads wakes nothing, so a snooze that ended while no copy of the module ran returns the item to the list but leaves a hidden band hidden. The plan's § 9 records this.

files.note: Registers and serves the tell tool, draws notices and the shared drawer actions, counts each kind in the divider, and wakes a hidden band when a snooze ends.

checks.text: A new item brings the band back only when it is not snoozed, so a snoozed item that first appears from another host stays quiet until it wakes.
snooze closes the drawer here because the snoozed item leaves the list. dismiss leaves its drawer open, and the dismissed item stays dim for a minute.
Only a hidden band checks for wakes. A shown band moves its clock on, the now value below, and isShownAt returns the woken item to the list on that render.

files.note: Adds the tell tool's description, schema, and argument builder, and the wokeBetween and snooze-aware isShownAt helpers; needsDelivery and answersIn now accept only questions.

checks.text: A notice never takes an answer from a sent prompt: answersIn filters to open questions before matching. The test a sent prompt answers snoozed questions and never a notice sends a prompt quoting a notice and expects no answer; it passed on this head.

files.note: Splits Item into the shared Posted fields and the Question and Notice kinds, and adds snoozedUntil.
Tests waking between two ticks, delivery and prompt answers for questions only, and the tell tool's arguments.
Tests the tell tool end to end, a notice's line and drawer, a dismissal that sends nothing, and snoozing with the band hidden.
